displayName: PMI KC A1 - Production Cloud Run 5xx

documentation.content: Production returned at least one 5xx during the five-minute pilot window. Check service health and contain any live effect before retrying.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.label."project_id" = "__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.label."location" = "__REGION__" AND resource.label."service_name" = "__SERVICE_NAME__" AND metric.label."response_code_class" = "5xx"
